description: Job listings from The Muse (US and remote companies): title, company, locations, posting date and link, newest first, optionally for a keyword. The Muse shows no salary, level or category on its listing cards. Returns one page of up to 20 jobs per call. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

page.description: Result page, 1 to 50 (default 1; 20 jobs per page)

q.description: Keyword, e.g. engineer, nurse, marketing (default: all jobs)
